_comment: The computed-route layer the routing plugin publishes into (its DEFAULT_LAYER_ID). It ships EMPTY on purpose: publishRoute() writes here at runtime. Until 25/08/2026 the demo profile had no such layer, so the routing button — deliberately visible since 23/08 — ended every computation on panel.showFailure('no-layer'): the showcase demonstrated a failure. Declaring the layer is what fixes the demo AND unblocks the two delivered-bundle proofs (ODbL credit, step labels) of e2e/35-routing-entry-point.spec.js.
